274899276.description:
OBSERVED FEATURES & INVENTORY
Mineral Hardness Kit:
Educational mineral specimen collection designed for studying mineral hardness.
Geoscience Industries Materials:
Instruction sheet marked "Geoscience Industries Ft. Collins, CO."
Hardness Reference Guide:
Included printed sheet titled "Hardness: A Property of Minerals."
Nine Specimen Tray:
White compartmented tray containing nine mineral specimens.
Numbered Samples:
Several specimens retain numbered identification stickers.
Compartmented Display Insert:
Molded white insert with individual specimen compartments.
Presentation Storage Box:
Brown hinged storage/presentation box included.
Varied Mineral Types:
Collection contains specimens of varying colors, translucency, textures, and crystal structures.
Instruction Sheet Content:
Reference sheet lists minerals associated with the Mohs hardness scale, including talc, gypsum, calcite, fluorite, apatite, feldspar, quartz, beryl-topaz, corundum, and diamond.
School Markings:
"B.L. Garza Middle School" text visible on the instruction sheet and inside the box lid.
Dimensions:
Approximately 7.25" x 5" x 1.5".
Weight:
Approximately 0.61 lbs.
PERCEIVED FLAWS & CONDITION NOTES
Used Educational Set:
Evidence of prior classroom, educational, or collection use.
Paper Wear:
Instruction sheet shows curling, creasing, wrinkles, and handling wear.
Box Wear:
Storage box exhibits edge wear, scuffs, surface marks, and age-related wear.
Tray Dust:
Minor dust, sediment, and mineral residue visible within some compartments.
Label Wear:
Number stickers show minor wear and aging.
School Ownership Markings:
School identification markings are present on included materials and box interior.
Specimen Identification Unverified:
Individual mineral identifications have not been independently verified beyond the included educational guide and numbering system.
Natural Mineral Imperfections:
Specimens display natural fractures, inclusions, uneven surfaces, and color variations consistent with mineral samples.
Completeness Not Guaranteed:
Nine specimens are present as photographed, but original factory completeness cannot be confirmed.
Storage Wear:
Minor rubbing and handling marks visible on specimens and container components.
Used AS-IS:
Item is offered in used condition as pictured. Only the mineral specimens, tray, box, and instruction sheet shown in the photographs are included.

274969046.description: A collection of polished agate and geode stone halves showcasing natural patterns and textures. These stones are ideal for decorative purposes, collections, or educational use.

275676579.description: This fossilized tooth section comes from a mammoth, featuring distinct tooth shapes and arrangement. The specimen exhibits mineralization with an adhesive or purple paint on a couple spots. The fossil is brownish with darker and lighter mineral inclusions and has a rough, natural texture. The underside reveals the internal structure of the teeth. It measures approximately 5 x 4.5 x 1.75 inches and weighs about 161.2 grams. The item is natural, unpolished (but has a sealant applied) condition, showing signs of age and mineralization, suitable for fossil collectors or educational use.
